title: deploy-center.json
description: The shared Deploy Center config at the root of a repo (also read as .deploy-center.json), from its default branch. Each Mac merges it below its own files: repo file < ~/.config/deploys. See docs/TEAM.md.

version.description: The format of this file. Only 1 exists.

approvals.description: Default for every project that deploys from this repo.

health.description: Default health path for every project that deploys from this repo.

window.description: Default deploy window for every project that deploys from this repo.

projects.description: Per project (the Vercel project or Render service name). A project named here deploys from this repo unless it says otherwise.

ignored.description:
Projects left out of `deploys changed` and `deploy-changed` (a Mac can count one again: deploys ignore

--undo).

groups.description: Projects deployed together, in order: `deploys deploy <group>` starts each one when the one before is live (backend before frontend).

observers.description: GitHub logins that may look but not deploy. Joined across all files and this Mac's overrides; a Mac cannot take a name off.

approvals.description: Two-person rule: how many people other than the deployer must approve the commit (a PR review, or the label deploy-approved-by:<login>). 0 is off. A Mac can raise it, not lower it.

health.description: Path checked after a deploy, e.g. /api/health.

window.description: When production deploys are allowed. ~/.config/deploys/window.json on a Mac replaces it.

tz.description: An IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Default UTC.

repo.description: owner/name; default: the repo this file is in.
